entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: The lines of what is considered[n]right and wrong in society today[n]have been blurred.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: With common sense no longer our[n]guide, we make decisions based on[n]our selfish wants and desires.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: This has resulted in a deluge of[n]self-centered people who delight[n]in taking advantage of the weak.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: However, even in this modern day[n]and age, it is imperative that we[n]act in the best interests of all.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: A world where it is acceptable to[n]trample on the rights of others for[n]your own benefit...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: A world where the young exist only[n]to be exploited... is a world[n]that must be changed!

entries.speaker: Elderly Woman
entries.en: Hmph, easy for him to say...[n]Old-timers like me have our hands[n]full taking care of ourselves.

entries.speaker: Young Man
entries.en: He's actually making some good[n]points, but he's a no-name...[n]He probably won't get too far.

entries.speaker: Young Man
entries.en: Nothing's going to change.[n]We'll just keep getting exploited.

entries.speaker: Grim-Faced Man
entries.en: ...What's this wannabe politician[n]blathering about now? He isn't[n]even affiliated with a party.

entries.speaker: Grim-Faced Man
entries.en: How about you just leave matters of[n]state in the capable hands of the[n]Liberal Co-Prosperity Party!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: You mustn't base your decision on[n]whom to support merely according[n]to the party they belong to...

entries.speaker: Grim-Faced Man
entries.en: Ah, just shut up already![n]You're just a washed-up politician!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: If I am chosen to represent the will of[n]the people, then I am fully prepared to...

entries.speaker: Grim-Faced Man
entries.en: "In the best interests of all"!? Hah!

entries.speaker: Grim-Faced Man
entries.en: Save the blathering for when you[n]get elected! ...IF you get elected!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you. That is all for today.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Well, what did you think of my speech?
"The best interests of all"?
I don't remember much of it.
Well, the heckling...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Indeed. Do you feel the same?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Such as I am, I'd like to believe that[n]I'm capable of giving a moving speech.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I see... Apparently, I still have[n]room for improvement.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Such as I am, I'd like to believe that[n]I'm capable of giving a moving speech.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Oh, don't worry about that.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Such as I am, I'd like to believe that[n]I'm capable of giving a moving speech.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...However, there are times, like[n]today, when the audience has a[n]difference of opinion on a topic.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Some feel I should concentrate[n]on getting elected before I worry[n]about others... Do you agree?
You have my support.
Yes, I agree with them.
You won't get elected?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you. It's encouraging to know[n]that my message has won you over.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That is difficult to hear said.[n]However, I don't disagree. I am[n]aware of the position I'm in.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I believe I can... if my message[n]connects with my audience.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Besides, I have grown quite accustomed[n]to those types of reactions...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Although... I don't know if that[n]is necessarily a good thing.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Regardless, no matter what[n]they say, I must continue on...
I think I can learn a lot by[n]listening to Yoshida's speeches...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Perhaps I'll ask for your[n]impressions again sometime.
